title: Stage 4 Prostate Cancer Thriver
content: Stage 4 Prostate Cancer ThriverRadical Remission ProjectMar 1, 20241 min readChuck Keels was diagnosed with stage 4 prostate cancer in May of 2015. His diagnosis was a surprise because Chuck was fit, healthy and strong. He has an amazing story of a divine interaction as part of his healing story. Chuck is a published author, Tedx speaker and the world’s best hugger. He is the founder of Living Hope Cancer Foundation where positive mindset coaching is his primary focus.
